name: foodsource
description: Поиск поставщиков продуктов питания с данными из MySQL

scripts.db:reset: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d
scripts.setup: docker compose up -d && node scripts/wait-for-mysql.js && node scripts/migrate-buyers-orders.js && node scripts/check-db.js && node scripts/seed-users.js && node scripts/seed-demo-accounts.js
scripts.db:reload: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d && node scripts/wait-for-mysql.js && node scripts/migrate-buyers-orders.js && node scripts/seed-users.js
scripts.db:fix-encoding: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d && node scripts/wait-for-mysql.js
scripts.db:init: mysql -u root -p < sql/schema.sql && mysql -u root -p foodsource < sql/seed.sql
